verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents a dedicated MTTX Analytics page that groups and visualizes incident metrics to show overall health, filterable by team, service, environment, severity, user and custom fields. A separate Alerting Analytics page tracks how events become alerts, how many are acknowledged, and how many become incidents, which speaks to incident and alert load. missing for 10: explicit on-call health metrics (e.g., responder burden or page load per person), explicit documentation of MTTA/MTTR trend-over-time views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
